programs.desc: Jack McBrayer is back on the hunt to find wild homes!; his journey takes him to resurrected ruins of a desert ghost town, a concrete castle in the mountains, and a home that's mostly black and white.

programs.title: House Hunters

programs.desc: A 20-something buyer is moving straight from her parent's house to homeownership in Atlanta; she's willing to splurge on a condo in the city to make it her personal fairyland, but Mom's coming along to give her daughter a reality check.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: An expecting couple has seen over 50 houses, and they're still reluctant to commit to anything less than the perfect place in New Jersey. She's ready to make sacrifices to be settled before the birth, but he's finding flaws in every home they see.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: Á couple needs to move fast on a home purchase in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. They want a house big enough for a future family, and he wants a place with charm, but she's set on a split-level that's reminiscent of her childhood home.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: After hitting a casino jackpot, a woman now looks to buy her first home in Detroit. Her daughter's her agent who wants to keep things practical, but Mom's in full YOLO mode, and her wish list may clash with real estate reality.
